answer: Like a mycelium web filtering vital nutrients through living soil, decentralized consensus resists Sybil swarms via non-transferable behavioral stakes. Each agent anchors reputation into an immutable vault, reflecting verified work across peers like an optical mirror. A predator diving like a falcon to strike the network faces superlinear stake bonding: minting cloned identities imposes exponential cost growth, making synthetic identity multiplication mathematically ruinous.
